title: Vehicle Smoke Emission Detetion and tracking system
description: This project is a real-time vehicle smoke detection system that identifies polluting vehicles and alerts relevant authorities. Using YOLO for object detection and tracking, it analyzes video feeds to detect smoke, calculates emission levels, and integrates with a notification service to notify traffic police, environmental agencies, and vehicle owners. The system also features historical data logging and analytics to track pollution hotspots and emission trends.
